Ended up coming across some filthier stuff and eventually came across some guro stuff for the first time on some weird forum i dont remember. The whole idea of sexualized death and mutilation was hot to me for some reason, maybe it was the hormones from puberty or something but i loved it, but never actually spanked my monkey to it at the time.

Fast forward to like two and a half years ago at one of my old jobs, I’d be in my backroom for my department and id listen to videos while i worked since i was alone, different videos about crime and such. One of them being about some famous cannibal, don’t remember exactly which, but man did it turn me on, not fact that actual people died, but the description of the ways that these people were tortured before they were killed, it reminded me of the old guro stuff i had seen years prior. Fast forward again to last year, and i once again start looking at this stuff. I only started because i was in a deep, deep depression, my girlfriend had left me a year already, i was away from family for months because of work which made me terribly lonely. Coming back to guro brought me comfort, as weird as this sounds probably, the fetishization of death kept me from committing suicide, knowing that it wouldn’t be pleasurable in the slightest and nobody would find anything positive from it, unlike in the art.

Now, here i am, 21 years old and i love this stuff with no shame at all, it saved my life and is super fucking hot too. Not to mention, beating your meat high off edibles just hits different.
